title: Compatible triangles realize the canonical compact-support projection compositor
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $k=\overline{k_0}$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and a uniformizer $t$; put $A_n=R/(t^n)$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the operation datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum], not a datum assuming projection invertibility. Schemes are finite type over $k$ and their structure morphisms need not be separated. Use the small pro-etale coefficient categories and the specified compactification projection map [def-exchange-projection], with compact-support functors [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be separated finite-type morphisms. Choose a compactification $Y\xhookrightarrow{i}\overline Y\xrightarrow{s}Z$ of $g$. There is a compatible compactification triangle with open immersions $j:X\hookrightarrow V$, $b:V\hookrightarrow\overline X$, proper maps $q:V\to Y$, $p:\overline X\to\overline Y$, $f=qj$, and $pb=iq$ Cartesian. All its schemes are finite-type, Noetherian and quasi-compact quasi-separated. At $A_n$, the direct-image and open comparisons of this triangle identify its normalized proper/open mate with the canonical compositor $\alpha_{g,f}:Rg_!Rf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(gf)_!$ of [thm-sf-comp-composition] on bounded etale-origin inputs. For $K\in D^b_c(X,A_n)$, $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Z,A_n)$ the projection composites therefore satisfy, after inserting on the right the canonical pullback-composition identification $L(gf)^*L\cong Lf^*Lg^*L$,
$$\alpha_{g,f,K\otimes^LLf^*Lg^*L}\,Rg_!(\operatorname{PF}_{f,K,Lg^*L})\,\operatorname{PF}_{g,Rf_!K,L}=\operatorname{PF}_{gf,K,L}(\alpha_{g,f,K}\otimes1_L).$$
All comparisons here are the specified counit-normalized direct-image, etale/pro-etale open-extension and open-composition maps. The identification respects threefold parenthesizations and identity morphisms. At the level of arbitrary strict semilinear system inputs, the same triangle and normalized operations give this equality before evaluation, with the system compositor of [lem-sf-composition-projection-mate].

proof.text: Apply the compatible compactification triangle existence theorem to the prescribed compactification (i,s). Construct V and W as the resulting pullback and ambient compactification, with their finite-type structure maps; properness and composition give finite type and quasi-compactness. Their Noetherianity follows from finite type over F.k. The pullback construction supplies both factorization equalities and Cartesianity. No separatedness of any structure morphism is used.

For each supplied Cartesian triangle apply lem-sf-cartesian-compact-support-compositor. It uses the original candidateCompositor definition, now shared by public import; canonical is exactly its factor-compactification specialization. Thus the equality requires no comparison of independently inferred compactification instances. This yields equality of raw alpha and canonical at every plus-etale-origin input.

Pull back constructibleFiniteTor L first along i s and then along j q using the source-library theorem constructibleFiniteTor_leftDerivedFunctor_upperStar_obj. For bounded constructible K and the pulled-back L, extract their bounded etale witnesses from the existing definition boundedConstructible. The comparison monoidality isomorphism provides the etale tensor as an origin witness for K tensor P_f P_g L. The source-library homologyConcentratedIn_tensor_of_torAmplitudeIn_right bounds its pro-etale image: choose bounds for K and use the given Tor interval of the second factor. Exact faithful comparison reflects boundedness by bounded_of_bounded_mapDerivedCategory_obj. Thus the etale tensor is bounded below. No finite Tor condition on K and no tensor constructibility theorem is required.

proof.text: Apply compositionProjectionMate to the supplied triangle and K,L. Expand leftMap and rightMap and rewrite raw alpha at K and at the tensor input by the preceding canonical identification. The resulting equality is exactly ProjectionEquation, with the specified trianglePull direction. The same theorem supplies ordinary and system associativity and the intrinsic system projection equation.

Ordinary identity compatibility is the two gamma identity fields of ambientProperOpenPasting. For arbitrary realizations, their gamma is the mate of the inverse mate, hence the recorded gamma itself. The canonical bridge conjugates its square to the canonical semilinear square. Adjunction uniqueness transports sId and jId through push and shriek respectively. Cancel those bridge isomorphisms and use the canonical semilinear vertical and horizontal gamma identities to obtain the two actual system identity equations.
